usage: Time 時間 is used to talk about the measurable period when things happen.
It can refer to specific points or durations, like 'What time is it?' or 'I don't have enough time.'
時間 is a noun, so it usually follows verbs or prepositions when used in sentences.
You can use 時間 with measure words like 個 (go3) when counting chunks of time.
It’s common to use 時間 in both formal and informal conversations about schedules, deadlines, and daily activities.
